prompts.scout: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet for Crown & Kingdoms, an original medieval isometric RTS. Reference image is identity and art style guidance, not an edit target. Create an ORIGINAL painted raster sheet, 1536x1024, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows (16 evenly spaced cells, each384x256). No text, labels, cell lines, scenery or ground plane. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha background, no baked checkerboard. Every character wholly contained in its own cell with generous transparent margins; no detached weapons or neighbour fragments. Fixed camera, light from upper left, same character size and feet baseline within every cell. Elevated isometric view about30degrees, all characters facing screen RIGHT with a slight view of front. Crisp miniature hand-painted realistic medieval sprites, earthy materials, dark readable contours, cobalt BLUE cloth identifies team, neutral leather/steel. Small clean distinct silhouette. Every frame has actual articulated limb/weapon changes; no duplicated poses or whole-body rotation. Subject: the mounted scout in the reference, a lightly armoured rider with blue cap, blue tunic and cream sleeves on a chestnut horse with dark mane and leather bridle/saddle. Distinct from the heavily armoured knight. Rider holds one short steel sword in right hand and reins in left. Horse and rider together count as one connected figure. No plate horse armour, no lance, no extra horses/legs/arms. Same horse/rider proportions throughout. Upper TWO rows, frames0-7: one continuous eight-frame horse trot cycle moving right, clear alternating diagonal hoof pairs, suspension and planted phases, rider follows saddle naturally, sword safe at side. Lower TWO rows, frames8-15: eight-frame mounted sword attack cycle:8ready sword upright;9draw sword back;10raise above shoulder;11windup;12full forward downward slash towards right at chest height;13follow through;14recover;15return to ready. Horse braces while attacking. Keep all hooves and sword tips inside their cell. Ready and attack horse body stays same height as walk. Avoid long shadows.
